wizard.title: Stellantis Account Configuration
wizard.already_text: Go straight to the remote control (OTP) step:
wizard.step2_title: Log in with your Stellantis account
wizard.s2_2: Open a new window and go to the link
wizard.s2_3: Log in with your Stellantis account
wizard.s2_4: The browser shows an error page (this is normal!)
wizard.s2_5: Open the developer tools and go to the Network tab
wizard.s2_6: Copy the complete URL from the network trace (mymap://oauth2redirect/nl?code=...&state=...)
wizard.s2_7: Paste it in the field below
wizard.otp_intro: Remote commands (for example air conditioning) need a one-time activation. Press "Send SMS", then enter the code from the SMS together with your Stellantis PIN.
wizard.otp_connected: Your account is connected. Request an SMS code to activate remote control.
wizard.connected_ok: ✅ Your Stellantis account has been connected!
wizard.invalid_url: Invalid URL. It must contain oauth2redirect.
wizard.no_code: No authorization code found in the URL.
wizard.state_mismatch: State mismatch (security error). Please start over.
wizard.otp_refreshed: ✅ OTP session refreshed, remote control is ready.
wizard.sms_sent: 📱 SMS sent. Enter the code from the SMS and your PIN below.
wizard.enter_both: Enter both the SMS code and your PIN.
wizard.otp_skipped: ✅ Account connected. Remote control is not activated; use "Request OTP" on the start screen later.

errors.vin_unknown: The VIN of the car is unknown
errors.remote_unavailable: Remote control is not available: log in first and activate the OTP in the app settings
errors.remote_client_unavailable: Remote client not available (not logged in or customer id not found)
errors.charge_time_unknown: The programmed charging start time of the car is unknown; refresh the vehicle status first or set a charging time in the car's app
errors.no_access_token_response: No access token in the response
errors.no_access_token_mqtt: No access_token in the MQTT token response
errors.otp_activation_failed: OTP activation failed. Check the SMS code and PIN.
errors.otp_finalize_failed: OTP activation could not be finalized: __result__
errors.otp_no_state: No OTP session found. SMS code and PIN are required for setup.
errors.otp_state_corrupt: The OTP session is corrupt. Authenticate again with a new SMS code.
errors.otp_session_expired: The OTP session has expired. Authenticate again with a new SMS code.
errors.otp_code_empty: The OTP code is empty. Authenticate again with a new SMS code.
errors.otp_config_invalid: The OTP configuration is invalid. Authenticate again.
errors.subscribe_refused: Subscribing to __topic__ was refused (the customer id is probably wrong)
errors.remote_not_initialized: Remote client not initialized. Call validateOTP first.
errors.mqtt_closed: Connection closed before it was established
errors.command_timeout: Timeout - no response received from the car (it may be asleep, try again)
errors.precond_0: air conditioning refused: the car is not switched off/parked
errors.precond_2: air conditioning refused: communication problem with the car
errors.precond_3: stopping refused: the car is not switched off/parked
errors.precond_4: stopping refused: no air conditioning is active
errors.charge_0: charging refused: the charging system is in standby (cable not connected?)
errors.charge_2: charging refused: communication problem with the charging system
errors.charge_3: charging refused: the engine is running
errors.doors_engine: doors refused: the engine is running
errors.doors_2: doors refused: a door is open
errors.doors_3: doors refused: a door is open or the key is inside
errors.doors_5: doors refused: the key is inside the car
errors.horn_0: horn refused: the engine is running
errors.horn_1: horn: already executed, wait before sending again
errors.lights_0: lights refused: the engine is running
errors.lights_2: lights: already executed, wait before sending again
errors.battery_health_unavailable: This car does not (yet) report its battery health
